{{Quote|Me make bridge! Get Ewok honey!|[[Gantu]]|<ref name="Ewoks 1">[[Ewoks (1985) 1|''Ewoks'' (1985) 1]]</ref>}}
[[File:Honey.jpg|thumb|250px|A jar of honey]]
'''Honey''' was a food enjoyed by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]].<ref name="Ewoks 1" /> As imitated by [[Abeloth]], [[Callista Ming]]'s [[Hair/Legends|hair]] was blonde- and honey-[[Color/Legends|colored]]. The word "honey" was also used metaphorically as a term of endearment.<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>
